findings.title: Pod's hostAliases send a Service's name to another address
findings.cause: container api exits because its connection to db fails: the pod's hostAliases write 10.96.255.250 db into its /etc/hosts, which is read before DNS, so the name db goes to 10.96.255.250 and not to Service db's cluster IP 10.96.66.210: no pod of the Service has that address, so every connection to db goes nowhere; its log says: "wget: download timed out"; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container api exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container api's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
connecting to the database at db:5432
Connecting to db:5432 (10.96.255.250:5432)
wget: download timed out

evidence.command: kubectl get pod api-698bb55b9f-24q9m -n kd-hostalias-stale-service-ip -o jsonpath='{.spec.hostAliases}'
kubectl get service db -n kd-hostalias-stale-service-ip -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}'

findings.fix: Remove db from the pod's hostAliases, so that it resolves through cluster DNS to Service db; hostAliases are for names DNS cannot answer.
